title: Emergence — tick() Result
description: The real return shape of loop.js's tick(text, target?) and server.js's POST /tick. Ties together observation.schema.json, created.schema.json, and the per-tick outputs of associative-lattice/causal-graph/event-ledger.

feedbackWindowSize.description: current size of the feedback-loop-buffer's ring buffer window, capped at its configured capacity (default 20).

invariants.description: the real invariant set extracted this tick -- trajectory:X, rupture:bool, decay:band, target-type:X, convergence:sig-or-none. See associative-lattice/component.spec.

nodeCount.description: TRUE total across restarts, per full sigma-baseline rehydration -- not just this session's count.

weight.description: Jaccard similarity of shared invariants -- 1.0 = identical invariant sets, 0 = nothing shared.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex of this node's persisted record.

dt.description: real elapsed simulation ticks since the previous creation. null only for the very first creation ever (no prior to compare against).

edgeType.description: dt <= causalWindowTicks (default 0.5, stated/tunable) -> causal/rule. Otherwise observational.

rejected.description: true if the real causal store rejected this edge (e.g. diamond-parent structural conflict) -- a real outcome, not swallowed.

endStateConditions.description: END-STATE FIRST: populated automatically the moment created.cluster is truthy (real convergence, not just 'a target was set'). null otherwise -- never fabricated.

pattern.description: NEW component (not a port), built on a real primitive found in scanners/crystalball-test-suite.html's PredictiveEngine. Recall is exact-match, not fuzzy. Prediction is null until a transition has genuinely repeated at least once.

signature.description: JSON-stringified fingerprint: trajectory, rupture, decay band, convergence state, and WHICH observer signals fired (not their values).

count.description: real prior occurrence count, before this tick is recorded

mostLikely.description: the signature that has historically followed the current one most often

path.description: backward walk through only real causal/rule edges -- stops at the first observational edge or missing parent. Real vendor/rfr2/causality/index.js traceToRoot(), not reimplemented.

truncated.description: true if maxDepth (default 50) was hit before reaching a root.

conditions.description: each step in path, with the real invariants that held at that node (associative-lattice.getInvariants(id)).
